mainEntity.name: How much does a full interior paint package cost in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Denver-area homeowners can expect a full interior repaint to land somewhere between $1,800 and $6,500 for a whole home, with projects that include ceilings, trim, and doors often costing more. Larger homes, higher ceilings, heavy prep, and premium paint can push the total higher.
acceptedAnswer.description: In the Denver metro, a full interior repaint often runs about $1,800 to $6,500, with walls-plus-ceilings-plus-trim usually at the higher end. Final price depends on size, prep, and finish level.
